title: 2027 Intern - FP&A Finance & Reporting
description:
The Opportunity
Join a high-visibility team managing worldwide consolidation for the GTM & Sales finance org while driving automation across multiple business processes. This internship offers hands-on experience in forecasting, predictive modeling, and process improvement, providing exposure to global finance operations!
What You'll Do
Support the creation and delivery of automated recurring weekly, monthly, and quarterly financial reports.
Help automate repetitive reporting tasks to reduce manual work and improve efficiency.
Explore and apply AI tools to improve reporting, automate routine tasks, summarize insights, and find opportunities to define Finance processes and make the more efficient.
Assist in creating standardized reporting packages that summarize key business and financial performance.
Work with Finance team members to understand reporting needs and help develop practical solutions.
Help build and maintain dashboards, reports, and presentation materials used by Finance Business Partners.
Perform data checks to help ensure reports are accurate and complete.
Reduce manual effort associated with recurring Finance reporting.
Improve the consistency and accessibility of financial information for financial liaison roles.
Help creates repeatable reporting processes that can be used by the broader team.
Identify practical opportunities to use automation and AI to improve the efficiency of Finance workflows.
Deliver process improvements that continue to benefit the team beyond the internship.
What You Need to Succeed
Currently enrolled full-time pursuing a Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Finance with a projected graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028.
Ability to participate in a full-time internship from May–September 2027
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Interest in Finance, FP&A, financial analysis, and business performance.
Working knowledge of Excel, Databricks, python and comfort working with data.
Interest in learning reporting, visualization, automation, and AI tools.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Ability to organize information and communicate findings clearly.
Ability to collaborate effectively and ask thoughtful questions.
Curiosity and willingness to learn new tools and processes.
Technical and Functional Skills
Data analysis and visualization
PowerPoint and presentation development
Exposure to tools such as Power BI, SQL, or Python is a plus
Interest in process automation and applying AI to Finance workflows
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills
Effective communication and collaboration skills
